concepts.statement_en: Infection involves germs entering and multiplying; symptoms alone do not establish or exclude infection.
Recognize direct and indirect contact exposure without equating any touch with infection.
Distinguish inhalation from direct deposition of infectious respiratory particles without rigid particle-size categories.
Recognize fecal-oral, vector, blood exposure and mother-to-child routes without stigmatizing or diagnosing people.
Reduce exposure at its source through prompt reporting and locally directed source-control measures.
Combine environmental and administrative/work-practice measures rather than relying on a single layer.
Choose PPE through task-specific risk assessment and training; PPE does not replace other controls.
Choose soap and water for visibly dirty hands; distinguish complete healthcare wash and handrub procedures.
Demonstrate all hand surfaces, rinse and dry correctly for washing; rub to dryness for handrub.
Recognize hand-hygiene moments in care and after glove removal; gloves do not replace hand hygiene.
Cover mouth and nose with tissue, or the bent elbow when tissue is unavailable; avoid coughing into hands.
Dispose of used tissue appropriately and perform hand hygiene after contact with respiratory secretions.
Report respiratory symptoms and follow the facility source-control and waiting-area process without diagnosis or stigma.
Apply the five food-safety principles to an observed household scene.
Protect drinking-water storage and seek verified treatment advice rather than assuming clarity means safety.
Use sanitation and hand hygiene to interrupt fecal contamination; refer engineering and treatment parameters for local confirmation.
Locate the locally applicable IPC policy, owner and current version rather than assuming possession means implementation.
Confirm task-specific authorization, instruction and observed competency; finding a policy does not authorize a specialist procedure.
Identify the immediate local reporting route for exposure or missing protection without self-directed treatment.
Record a specific observed IPC supply or practice gap without inventing observations or blaming people.
Assign a feasible action, owner and follow-up through the facility IPC process.
Verify improvement with an observable measure and record unresolved barriers; observed competence is distinct from quiz completion.
